title: sse: fix partial-JSON delimiter ordering and token/event framing across chunks
author: Ava Chen
description: Fixes a class of SSE framing bugs that could produce malformed partial JSON events when chunk boundaries split delimiters or token/event orderings. Background: downstream OpenAI-compatible clients observed intermittent JSON parse errors when a token event and the trailing JSON delimiter were split across TCP chunks (or when multiple small token events were coalesced incorrectly). This PR reworks the SSE framing encoder to guarantee deterministic ordering between token events and delimiter markers, emits explicit delimiter tokens when partial-json mode is enabled, and updates the OpenAI compatibility adapter to follow the expected 'data:' event ordering. Changes include: deterministic delimiter emission, boundary-aware buffering of partial-json payloads, unit + integration tests, and a small performance micro-optimization to avoid extra copies. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce test case in unit tests - [x] Add regression tests for token/event ordering across chunk boundaries - [x] Update OpenAI compatibility adapter and docs - [x] Run e2e streaming regression harness (ci) Related: ENG-1452 (streaming stability), ENG-1468 (openai compat regressions). More details in commits and file list below.
